name: writing-skills
why: The discipline half of skill authoring: skills as TDD — baseline a failing scenario, write the minimal document that closes it, pressure-test with subagents, then plug the loopholes. Ships Anthropic's best-practices reference, a bulletproofing checklist and a persuasion-principles guide.
caveats: The subagent testing harness assumes Claude Code; the authoring method and references work anywhere.
